_note: Register fragment for capability-rows-get-requirements (REQ-CRR-003). An archive decision hands the publication to OpenRegister's e-Depot transfer; the publication keeps the transfer reference and how it went, so an officer sees it without opening OpenRegister.

edepotTransfer.title: e-Depot transfer
edepotTransfer.description: The transfer of this publication to the e-depot, started by an archive decision: OpenRegister's transfer reference, its status (requested, transferred or failed) and, for a failed transfer, the reason.

reference.title: Transfer reference
reference.description: The uuid of OpenRegister's transfer list; empty when the transfer could not be started.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the transfer failed, as the e-depot or OpenRegister gave it.
